# Enrichment fixtures

These files are hand-written. They are not captured from real scans. Their
shape follows the JSON-lines output of naabu v2.6.1 (`-json`), httpx v1.12.0
(`-json -td`) and zgrab2 v1.0.0 (`multiple`). All addresses are in the
192.0.2.0/24 documentation range. CI does not need any of these tools
installed.
